To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the VTEC isolated from sporadic cases in Akita Pref. were all eae positive and harbored approximately 50 MDa plasmids.
the 6 VETC strains isolated from sporadically occurring diarrhea in Akita prefecture possessed eae gene and approximately 60 MDA CVD419 probe-hybridizing plasmid, suggesting their pathogenicity.
the 6 V. cholerae strains isolated from sporadically infected patients in Akita Pref. were of serotype O157:H7, and that all of these isolates were positive for eae and 60 MDa CVD plasmid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characteristics of VTEC strains which caused sporadic diarrhea in the residents of Akita prefecture.
the characterization of VTEC isolated in sporadic cases of diarrhea in Akita prefecture.
epidemiological characteristics of VTEC in Akita Pref., and the results will be useful to understand the mechanism of the pathogenesis of VTEC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all of the 6 sporadic cases of diarrhea in Akita prefecture in the recent 4 years were due to infection with VTEC.
the 6 VTC strains isolated in Akita Pref. were all of the eae-positive VTEC strains.
VTEC is a pathogen which can cause sporadic diarrhea and that the pathogen has been widely distributed and has caused infections in humans in Japan.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the 6 VETC strains isolated in sporadic cases of diarrhea in Akita prefecture were genetically and serologically different, and that they might have originated from different sources, which were not identified in this study.

the 6 VETC isolates from the sporadic diarrhea cases in Akita Pref. are genetically and serotypically similar to those isolated in other parts of the country, and that eae gene is an important factor in the pathogenicity of VTEC.
VTEC infection is a serious health problem in Japan.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the eae gene and a 60 MDa virulence plasmid are important in pathogenesis of E. coli O157:H7 and other VTEC strains.
VTEC strains are distributed throughout Japan, and the strains isolated in Akita Pref. were similar to those in the United States and Europe in terms of serotype, toxin type, eae gene and plasmid.
VTEC is a major cause of sporadic cases of diarrhea in Akita prefecture.
